notes.3: 5 per cent of candidates chose the correct answer, D. The most commonly chosen incorrect option was A. Option A is true of the 3p subshell, which can hold a maximum of six electrons, but is not true of a 3p orbital, which can hold two electrons. In an isolated phosphorus atom, each 3p orbital is occupied by one electron, so D is correct.
